title: What Thru-Hiking Is All About
description: Thru-hikers walk entire long-distance trails — the Appalachian, Pacific Crest, or Continental Divide — over months, carrying everything they need. It's equal parts physical challenge, simplicity, and community. The Triple Crown trails plus the Long Trail, Colorado Trail, and international routes (Te Araroa, GR5). Trail towns form the support culture. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.

title: History and Evolution
description: Thru-hiking culture began with Earl Shaffer's 1948 AT thru-hike. The Triple Crown (AT, PCT, CDT) became the pinnacle; 'Wild' and social media brought mainstream awareness in the 2010s. Knowing where the craft came from explains why things are done the way they are — and which 'rules' are just old habits.
